children: Uranium Royalty reported revenue of $51.0 million and net income of $16.3 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026. The company sold 593,255 lbs of U3O8 at an average realized price of approximately $86.00/lb and used proceeds to help fund its July 2026 Sweetwater acquisition. Diluted earnings per share rose to $0.10 for the quarter.
Financial Highlights
Revenue:
$51.0 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026.
Cost of sales:
$34.1 million (approximately $57.40/lb) related to uranium sales.
Average realized price:
Approximately $86.00 per pound of U3O8 sold.
Net income:
$16.3 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (1530% increase year-over-year).
Diluted earnings per share:
$0.10 for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (900% increase year-over-year).
Business Highlights
Completed the Sweetwater transaction in July 2026, materially expanding scale and diversifying the company's royalty platform and land holdings.
Holds a total land position exceeding 5.3 million acres (surface and minerals), positioning it as the largest landowner in Wyoming and the second largest publicly traded landowner in the U.S.
Approximately 38,000 acres from Sweetwater were leased with active exploration for oil and gas potential near established production.

Uranium royalty counterparties largely maintained production guidance (including Cameco at Cigar Lake and McArthur River/Key Lake; Paladin’s Langer Heinrich exceeded FY2026 guidance), supporting portfolio outlook.
Soda ash assets in Wyoming continue to show resilient production and expansion potential, supported by operators positioned at the lower end of the global cost curve.
